name: OWF Akron City Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own hometown title, defended in the opening match of the fed's first-ever card, Sunday Inferno (1 November 1998), between "Flashy" Michael Robinson and Red Raider -- billed on the fed's own Buckeye Buzz newsletter as a clash of former EMWO champions.

name: OWF Buckeye Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own flagship singles title, held by "Mr. Charisma" Christian York into the fed's first card, Sunday Inferno (1 November 1998), where he defended it against "The Disciple" Eric Wayne in the main event.

name: OWF Lightweight Championship
epitaph: A tournament title whose semi-finals ran on the fed's first card, Sunday Inferno (1 November 1998); its own newsletter previewed "Sudden Death" Shane Matthews as the promotion's own pick to win the inaugural tournament.

name: OWF Cincinnati Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own tag team championship, run out of Cincinnati; Cold Justice won it at the promotion's own Christmas Carnage and were billed defending it in a four-way match at the promotion's own closing SnowScraps: Termination card, whose own outcome does not survive the record.
